snippet.title: Annalog Trailer (NES)
snippet.description:
ANNALOG is a Metroidvania coming to NES! 🔥🎮

Explore a complex world full of enemies, dynamic puzzles, huge bosses, and a lot of charm! ⭐️

Never before seen tech used on NES, and it's coming to Kickstarter!💪 
Click to be notified on launch 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/elland/annalog-nes
